intro: Every public meeting where Garland County's decisions get made — sourced like everything else here. These rooms are open to you, and most are nearly empty. Showing up counts double when almost nobody does.

recurring.name: Garland County Quorum Court — regular session
recurring.place: Garland County Courthouse, 501 Ouachita Ave, Hot Springs
recurring.note: The thirteen justices of the peace who vote the county budget. Public; residents may speak. (An unofficial search result named the Armory at 200 Woodbine; the county's own Quorum Court page and Arkansas 211 both list the Courthouse — confirm the room before you go.)
recurring.source: Garland County Quorum Court page (garlandcounty.org/243) and Arkansas 211.

recurring.name: Hot Springs Board of Directors
recurring.place: City Hall, 133 Convention Blvd, Hot Springs
recurring.note: The seven-member board that adopts the city budget. City-manager government (City Manager Bill Burrough). Meetings are open.
recurring.source: City of Hot Springs Board page (hotspringsar.gov/223) and dated agendas.

seasonal.banner: Budget season: in the last quarter, the quorum court writes next year's county budget. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said in these meetings — or waits a year.

community.invite: Community events belong here too — recycling drives, cleanups, blood drives. Send it through the question box with the date and place.
